grid_kgco2e_per_kwh.source: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector v17.0, weighted average, FY2020-21 (CO2 only). Replace with the latest CEA version.

gwp_ch4.source: IPCC AR5 100-year GWP for methane. AR6 gives 27.0 (non-fossil) and 29.8 (fossil); use the report your target registry requires.

landfill_kgco2e_per_kg_organic.source: MoEFCC / NITI Aayog national waste sector modeling assumptions for deep unmanaged Indian dumpsites: High-decomposition DOCf 0.77 (due to approximately 35°C average landfill temperature), DOC 0.15, MCF 0.8, F 0.5, multiplied by 16/12 and GWP 28. Assumes 0% gas recovery and 0% surface oxidation.

truck_kgco2e_per_tkm.source: UK Defra/BEIS conversion factors 2025, rigid diesel HGV average laden, 0.19748, via Climatiq. UK vehicles; India values differ.
